author: blu
body: Proves lords (tribal anthems). Lord of Atlantis carries TribalBoost "Merfolk" 1 1: the controller's OTHER Merfolk get +1/+1, summed dynamically at read time like an anthem. A 1/1 Merfolk of the Pearl Trident is 2/2 while the Lord is in play and 1/1 without it. The Lord does not pump itself (Other Merfolk), so it stays 2/2.
